# Primitive, Pipeline, and Runtime Catalog — 8,000 Candidate Rows

Generated for AIDevExplorer / AIDevObserver / Teleon-style primitive expansion.

This file is designed to be copied, pasted, chunked, imported, or split into JSONL later. It intentionally stores **candidate** primitive groups and end-to-end pipelines, not promoted truth. Every row keeps `candidate=true` and `serves_truth=false` until source refs, implementation evidence, contract tests, side-effect reviews, and runtime receipts prove it.

## Design stance

The useful unit is not only a small function. The useful unit is often a **start-to-finish route**:

```text
Input data + policy + runtime target -> deterministic route -> output artifact + receipt
```

The LLM should first see compact edges and route summaries, then drill into member edges, schemas, tests, source slices, or code only when needed.

## Source map

| source_family | why_it_matters | source_url |
| --- | --- | --- |
| OpenAPI | HTTP API endpoint primitive contracts | https://swagger.io/specification/ |
| AsyncAPI | event/message-driven API primitives | https://www.asyncapi.com/docs/reference/specification/latest |
| JSON Schema | structured input/output validation contracts | https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/json-schema-validation |
| MCP tools | agent tool primitive schemas and tool-call wrappers | https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/draft/server/tools |
| Airflow | scheduled task/DAG orchestration primitives | https://airflow.apache.org/docs/apache-airflow/stable/core-concepts/dags.html |
| Dagster | asset-centric data pipeline primitives | https://docs.dagster.io/guides/build/assets/defining-assets |
| Temporal | durable workflow and saga primitives | https://docs.temporal.io/workflow-execution |
| Spark | batch/stream large-scale data engineering primitives | https://spark.apache.org/docs/latest/ |
| Flink | stateful streaming primitives | https://nightlies.apache.org/flink/flink-docs-stable/ |
| Beam | unified batch/stream pipeline primitives | https://beam.apache.org/documentation/basics/ |
| Kafka | event streaming and stream processing primitives | https://kafka.apache.org/documentation/ |
| NiFi | dataflow automation and routing primitives | https://nifi.apache.org/docs/nifi-docs/html/overview.html |
| Airbyte | ELT/connectors/data movement primitive source | https://docs.airbyte.com/ |
| dbt Semantic Layer | semantic metrics and data model primitives | https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/use-dbt-semantic-layer/dbt-sl |
| Kubernetes Jobs | cloud-deployable batch/one-off task runtime shape | https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/job/ |
| GitHub Actions | CI/CD and repo automation primitive source | https://docs.github.com/actions |
| Terraform modules | IaC reusable module primitives | https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/modules |
| Docker Hub | container-image runtime primitive source | https://hub.docker.com/ |
| PyPI | Python package/function primitive mining source | https://pypi.org/ |
| npm | JavaScript package/action primitive mining source | https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v8/using-npm/registry/ |
| Hugging Face Hub | model/dataset/Space primitive mining source | https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/en/index |
| OpenTelemetry | trace/metric/log proof and telemetry primitives | https://opentelemetry.io/docs/ |

## Dimension cheat sheet

| dimension | example_values |
| --- | --- |
| data shape | scalar; record; nested object; array; record batch; wide table; long table; sparse table; graph; DAG; stream; document; image; video; vector index |
| transform family | parse; extract; validate; normalize; map; dedupe; reconcile; classify; score; forecast; route; approve; render; generate; evaluate; sync; compile |
| runtime shape | local function; API endpoint; MCP tool; CLI command; queue worker; cron job; workflow step; cloud function; Kubernetes job; GitHub Action; Terraform module; browser script |
| proof | unit test; contract test; fixture test; smoke test; source-span check; idempotency test; side-effect audit; privacy review; benchmark scorecard |
| effect | file read/write; database read/write; network read/write; model call; shell execution; cloud resource create; audit log write; notification write |
| evidence level | plausible candidate; source-family-backed; source-ref-backed; implementation-backed; benchmark-backed; promoted truth |

## Column schema

| column | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `row_id` | stable row number within this generated file |
| `primitive_group_id` | candidate primitive/group identifier |
| `category` | pipeline class such as data engineering, software engineering, AI/RAG, business ops, media, or guardrail |
| `pipeline_family` | human-readable family name |
| `industry` | industry specialization overlay |
| `use_case` | realistic business/developer use case |
| `input_edge` | visible input contract |
| `input_data_formats` | physical input formats |
| `input_structure` | logical input shape |
| `schema_or_standard` | standard or custom schema hints |
| `start_to_finish_route` | hidden route summary compressed into one field |
| `output_edge` | visible output contract |
| `output_formats` | physical output artifacts |
| `runtime_shape` | where/how this can run |
| `known_implementations` | tools, packages, or platforms commonly used to implement this route |
| `source_refs` | source families to mine/verify before promotion |
| `effects` | declared side effects |
| `guardrails` | safety/policy controls |
| `proof_requirements` | minimum tests/receipts before use |
| `cache_key` | cache invalidation dimensions |
| `variation_dimensions` | dimensions used to specialize the primitive |
| `evidence_level` | how strong the evidence is today |
| `candidate` | always true for this generated pack |
| `serves_truth` | always false until promoted |
